title: APCW-2025-2220-SPPE-CU2-SPPC-CDP
text:
APCW-2025-2220-SPPE-CU2-SPPC-CDP  Council District: 11 – Park
  CEQA: ENV-2025-2222-CE  Last Day to Act: 08-20-26
  Plan Area: Venice

  PUBLIC HEARING – Completed June 15, 2026

  PROJECT SITE:  305 East Rose Avenue and 254 South Hampton Drive

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Change of use of an existing 5,765 square-foot two-story church to a 5,765 square-foot private club
  including a commercial kitchen, co-working space and a lounge, providing 161 seats and 20 bicycle parking
  spaces; the project also includes new hardscape and minor façade improvements.
  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, an Exemption from CEQA
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines Sections 15301, 15303 and 15331, and that there is no substantial
  evidence demonstrating that an exception to the Categorical Exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines
  Section 15300.2 applies;
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1A Section 13B.4.5, of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), a Specific Plan
  Exception to allow zero parking spaces in lieu of the required 77 spaces as otherwise required by
  Section 13D of the Venice Coastal Zone Specific Plan;
  3. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.24 W.35 and Chapter 1A Section 13.B.2.2, a Class 2
  Conditional Use Permit for the establishment of a private club within the RD1.5-1 Zone;

  4. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.4.2, a Project Permit Compliance Review for a project
  within the Oakwood Subarea of the Venice Coastal Zone Specific Plan; and
  5. Pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1A Section 13B.9.1, a Coastal Development Permit for a Development
  within the Single Permit Jurisdiction of the California Coastal Zone.

  Applicant:  305 Rose Avenue, LLC
  Representative: Brian Silveira, Brian Silveira & Associates

  Staff:  Sienna Kuo, Planning Assistant
